criteria.reason: The workout exercise menu includes a “Skip Exercise” option.
Selecting it opens a confirmation modal before applying the skip.
The client submits every current-week set with status `skipped`, and the server stores that status.
The card shows a “Skipped” badge when all current-week sets are skipped.
The menu offers “Resume Exercise,” which removes the skipped set records during the session.
The existing `/sets` endpoint handles skipped status.
No new server test is included in the diff.
No new client test is included in the diff.
The harness reports all 197 server and 289 client tests passing.
The added UI copy uses direct language and contains no exclamation marks.
